# meraki_connect_appliance_umbrella_account (Action)

This action can invoke the `Connect Appliance Umbrella Account` operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "meraki_connect_appliance_umbrella_account" "example" {
  config {
    network_id = "N_24329156"
    api_key    = "1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678"
    api_secret = "abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String) API key for the Umbrella account
- `api_secret` (String) API secret for the Umbrella account
- `network_id` (String) Network ID
